## About
# About

I design and build web experiences with a bias toward clarity, accessibility, and maintainable systems.

My work sits between frontend implementation and visual design. I like translating messy requirements into tidy interfaces and reusable systems.

This portfolio is structured around case studies so each project can explain the context, constraints, decisions, and measurable outcomes behind the final screen.

A blog will live here later. The content model already leaves room for long-form notes, technical writing, and design breakdowns.

## Working principles
- Design for readability before decoration.
- Treat accessibility as product quality, not a checklist.
- Document decisions so future collaborators and future agents can follow the reasoning.

## Projects
# Design System Refresh

- Year: 2026
- Client: SaaS Platform
- Role: Frontend developer + design systems support
- Stack: React, TypeScript, SCSS, Storybook

## Summary
A case study on cleaning up inconsistent UI patterns and aligning design and implementation.

## Challenge
The product had visual drift, duplicated components, and inconsistent behavior across breakpoints.

## Approach
- Audited components and grouped repeated patterns into a smaller token-based system.
- Aligned spacing, typography, and state patterns across the highest-traffic flows.
- Documented usage notes so future work could extend the system instead of bypassing it.

## Outcome
- Reduced visual inconsistency in core journeys.
- Made future page work faster by establishing reusable building blocks.
- Improved handoff between design and development.

# Content-First Portfolio Rebuild

- Year: 2026
- Client: Personal Brand
- Role: Product designer + frontend developer
- Stack: React, TypeScript, SCSS, Cloudflare Pages

## Summary
A personal site rebuild focused on stronger project storytelling, clearer structure, and better machine readability.

## Challenge
The older portfolio showed visuals but not enough context, which made it harder for recruiters, collaborators, and AI tools to understand the work.

## Approach
- Shifted from gallery-style presentation to case-study style narratives.
- Created markdown mirrors, llms.txt resources, and structured metadata for machine access.
- Left room in the information architecture for a future writing section.

## Outcome
- Clearer project framing for hiring and client conversations.
- Better discoverability for both humans and agents.
- A maintainable base for future blog content.

# WordPress Performance Audit

- Year: 2025
- Client: Content Publisher
- Role: Frontend developer
- Stack: WordPress, PHP, SCSS, JavaScript

## Summary
A performance and UX cleanup effort for a content-heavy website.

## Challenge
The site suffered from heavy theme code, layout inconsistencies, and weak mobile navigation.

## Approach
- Removed dead styles and narrowed CSS to the components actually in use.
- Fixed responsive navigation behavior and simplified key templates.
- Prioritized readable content blocks and lighter page structure.

## Outcome
- Improved mobile experience and maintainability.
- Reduced styling debt in critical templates.
- Created a cleaner base for future content work.
